features: Adds Salsa Rising and Salsa Open as full BDC special competition categories across the live BDC workflow
Salsa divisions are now Novice, Intermediate, Advanced, Salsa Rising and Salsa Open on the Competitor Portal and Admin competitor editor
Salsa Rising and Salsa Open use the same fixed placement point schedule as Bachata Rising and Bachata Open: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 for places 1 through 5
Special-category points are written only to the Salsa ledger and are assigned to each dancer's current Salsa Novice, Intermediate or Advanced progression bucket
Extends scoring, registration, publication, participant-result, discipline-profile and points-tier enums to support Salsa Rising/Open safely
Scoring Dashboard dynamically shows Salsa Rising/Open only when Salsa is selected while Bachata special categories remain Bachata-specific
Final publication now routes through a discipline/category-aware gate so normal Salsa, Salsa Rising/Open, normal Bachata and Bachata special categories use the correct approval path
Salsa Rising/Open publication preserves the existing Super Admin approval workflow and generates Heats, Final and Final Ranking & Points repository documents
Bachata Invitational remains Bachata-only; no Salsa Invitational, Semi Pro, Pro or All Star category is introduced
Public Results remain discipline-separated and the main Leaderboard remains progression-based on Novice, Intermediate and Advanced buckets
The isolated legacy Scoring Tests Dashboard is intentionally not converted to multi-dance Salsa special categories in this release
Automatic judge scoring now enforces the configured YES limit separately for Leaders and Followers and blocks any extra YES selection immediately
A1, A2 and A3 can each be assigned only once per judge per role, with both browser-side feedback and server-side validation
Automatic scoring judge screens now show live YES and alternate counters and clear validation messages when a selection is blocked
Automatic scoring submission now requires the configured YES count rather than incorrectly requiring every competitor to receive a YES or alternate mark
